BiblicalUsage: Nehemiah brings up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appoints two great companies of them that give thanks, to go in procession, one to the right hand upon the wall. The word is a procession, a going in order: the thanksgiving companies walking the wall at the dedication. It appears once, on the day Jerusalem's wall is dedicated.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the procession is the dedication itself: the wall is not finished until the people walk it giving thanks, and the thanks go up before the work is done.
